festivals.name: G.O.N.D. Festival
festivals.description: G.O.N.D. Festival (short for 'Gegen Onkelz Normale Depression') is a German rock festival born from the spirit of Böhse Onkelz fans after the band's farewell concert at Lausitzring in 2005. The multi-day event features Onkelz cover bands alongside Deutschrock, metal, and rock acts across multiple stages including the Main Stage, Indoor Stage, and Paint Stage.

festivals.name: Drumherum Festival
festivals.description: Drumherum is Germany's largest folk music festival, held every two years around Pentecost in the Bavarian Forest town of Regen. Over 50,000 visitors enjoy performances by 300+ ensembles from Bavaria and across Europe, with music filling the spa park, town squares, and local inns alongside craft markets and dance workshops.

festivals.name: Elbjazz Festival
festivals.description: Elbjazz is one of Germany's most distinctive jazz festivals, transforming Hamburg's harbor into a world-class music venue since 2010. The festival features around 50 international jazz, soul, and blues acts performing at unique waterfront locations including the iconic Elbphilharmonie concert hall and historic Blohm+Voss shipyards, with special launch boats ferrying festival-goers between stages.
festivals.venue: Hamburg Harbour, Elbphilharmonie & Blohm+Voss Shipyards, 20457 Hamburg

festivals.name: HöpenAir Festival
festivals.description: HöpenAir is a beloved community rock festival held at the open-air stage in Höpental valley near Schneverdingen since 1985. Organized by volunteer youth groups, this family-friendly single-day event offers 4-5 live rock and alternative acts in nature, with free admission for children under 15.

festivals.name: Metal Frenzy Festival
festivals.description: Metal Frenzy Open Air is an intimate metal festival held at the Gardelegen water park since 2013. Festival-goers can camp directly next to the stage in a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere, enjoying diverse metal subgenres from thrash and death to power metal across four days.

festivals.name: Raptor Metalcore Festival
festivals.description: Raptor is a single-day indoor metalcore festival in Königsbrunn featuring eight bands across metalcore, deathcore, and hardcore genres. The community-driven event at MatriX venue brings together fans, musicians, and metal enthusiasts for an intense day of heavy music regardless of weather.

festivals.name: Frostfeuernächte
festivals.description: Frostfeuernächte is a unique winter metal festival held south of Berlin at the KiEZ Hölzerner See holiday camp. The cozy indoor event offers extreme metal music in a frosty February setting, with on-site accommodation available for attendees seeking a full weekend experience.
festivals.venue: KiEZ Hölzerner See, Weg zum Hölzernen See 1, 15754 Heidesee OT Gräbendorf

festivals.name: Supremacy - Germany Decoded
festivals.description: Supremacy - Germany Decoded brings the world's biggest raw hardstyle event from the Netherlands to Germany's Westfalenhalle Dortmund. This one-day indoor festival showcases the most powerful and intense sounds in the rawstyle and hardstyle scene, attracting up to 15,000 hardcore electronic music fans.

festivals.name: Rock am Ring
festivals.description: Rock am Ring is one of the world's most legendary rock festivals, held at the iconic Nürburgring racing circuit since 1985. The three-day twin festival (alongside Rock im Park) draws over 70,000 fans for a massive lineup of rock, metal, and alternative headliners on the historic German motorsport venue.

festivals.name: Rock im Park
festivals.description: Rock im Park is one of Germany's flagship rock festivals, held annually at Nuremberg's historic Zeppelinfeld since 1997. As the twin festival to Rock am Ring, it shares the same world-class lineup of rock, metal, and alternative acts across three days in the heart of the city.
festivals.venue: Volkspark Dutzendteich, Zeppelinfeld, Münchener Str. 283, 90471 Nürnberg

festivals.name: Hurricane Festival
festivals.description: Hurricane Festival is one of Germany's largest rock and alternative festivals, celebrating its 30th anniversary in 2026. Held at the Eichenring speedway in Scheeßel near Hamburg, it draws over 80,000 fans for three days of rock, indie, pop, and electronic music alongside its twin festival Southside.

festivals.name: Southside Festival
festivals.description: Southside Festival is one of Germany's premier rock festivals, held annually in Neuhausen ob Eck near Lake Constance. As the twin to Hurricane Festival, it shares the same world-class lineup across three days at the former military airfield Take-Off Park.

festivals.name: Rockharz Festival
festivals.description: Rockharz is a legendary metal festival held at the airfield in Ballenstedt in the Harz mountains. The 33rd edition features over 50 bands across two open-air stages over four days, offering an intimate metal experience with camping directly at the venue.

festivals.name: Meadow Festival
festivals.description: Meadow Festival was a metal and metalcore festival near Feuchtwangen in Franconia. Unfortunately, the 2026 edition has been cancelled due to the organizer's insolvency.

festivals.name: Ohne Watt Festival
festivals.description: Community festival in Klützer Winkel organized by Winkelleu e.V. Features camping, campfires, acrobatics, juggling, theater, and live music with all beaches reachable by bicycle.

festivals.name: Airbeat One Festival
festivals.description: Airbeat One is one of Europe's largest electronic music festivals, held at the former military airfield in Neustadt-Glewe. Each year features a different country theme, with 2026 celebrating the Netherlands across 7 stages with over 160 artists and 200,000+ attendees.

festivals.name: Afrikanisches Kulturfest
festivals.description: Afrikanisches Kulturfest is an annual celebration of African culture and music in Frankfurt's Rebstockpark. The 18th edition offers three days of reggae and African music, an African market, Caribbean cocktails, and cuisine from 7 African countries.

festivals.name: EONLY Festival
festivals.description: Intimate electronic music festival in Leipzig's atmospheric Altes Stadtbad, now in its 15th edition. Just 800 attendees enjoy 16 artists performing without overlapping sets in the historic bathhouse.

festivals.name: Hell Over Hammaburg
festivals.description: Hell Over Hammaburg is a cult gathering for devotees of doom, heavy, and black metal underground, held at Hamburg's Markthalle. The 12th edition features a strictly non-commercial, music-first experience with international underground bands.

festivals.name: Fuck Cancer Festival
festivals.description: Fuck Cancer Festival is a metal charity event in Ahrensburg, bringing metalheads together to support those fighting cancer. The indoor festival at JuKi 42 venue features death and extreme metal acts.

festivals.name: Metal Franconia Festival
festivals.description: Annual metal festival in Geiselwind featuring 18 bands across 2 days. The 14th edition brings international acts like Hypocrisy and Abbath alongside emerging metal talent.

festivals.name: Festival der Zukunft
festivals.description: Technology and innovation festival hosted at the iconic Deutsches Museum in Munich. Explores future technologies, sustainability, and creative visions for tomorrow through exhibitions and performances.

festivals.name: splash! Festival
festivals.description: splash! is Germany's most significant hip-hop festival, held at the iconic Ferropolis 'City of Iron' industrial museum near Leipzig. Five massive mining excavators tower over 30,000 fans enjoying hip-hop and reggae across 8 stages over three days.

festivals.name: Protzen Open Air
festivals.description: Protzen Open Air is a death metal and grindcore festival held north of Berlin. Around 35 bands perform across 2 stages over three days in a specially equipped party barn, offering an authentic underground metal experience.

festivals.name: E-Tropolis Festival
festivals.description: E-Tropolis is Germany's premier EBM, industrial, and dark electro festival, held at the legendary Turbinenhalle in Oberhausen. The 14th edition features two stages with the best of synthpop, aggrotech, and electro-industrial in a raw industrial setting.

festivals.name: Heidelberg Deathfest
festivals.description: Ninth edition of this one-day death metal gathering at halle02 Heidelberg. Features international extreme metal acts plus a metal market, chill-out lounge, and food area.

festivals.name: Sojus 7 Bootstour
festivals.description: 7th edition of the 'moving punk rock ship' on the Rhine. Unique floating festival experience with punk, rock, and ska acts aboard MS Fantasy. Reduced tickets for volunteers and students.
festivals.venue: MS Fantasy, Bootsanleger, 40789 Monheim am Rhein

festivals.name: Dark Easter Metal Meeting
festivals.description: Munich's premier extreme metal indoor festival since 2012, now in its 13th edition. Two days of Black, Dark, Death, and Doom Metal across three Backstage stages with no overlapping sets on main stages.

festivals.name: Easter Cross Festival
festivals.description: Two-day indoor metal festival at Neckarhalle featuring a perfect mix of Metal, Hardcore, and Punkrock. Established Easter event bringing together international acts and emerging talent.

festivals.name: Ragnarök Festival
festivals.description: Ragnarök Festival is one of the most significant pagan, viking, and black metal indoor festivals in the German-speaking region. Held at Stadthalle Lichtenfels with 3,500 capacity, the three-day event offers an intense concert experience.

festivals.name: Jazztage Ilmenau
festivals.description: One of Germany's longest-running jazz festivals, founded in 1972 in Thuringia. Celebrates over 50 years of bringing international and national jazz artists to intimate venues throughout Ilmenau.

festivals.name: MOSHnMAY Festival
festivals.description: Indoor metal festival in a steel hall near Osnabrück. Features Death Metal and Heavy Metal across two days with barrier-free access. Adults only (18+) event since 2016.

festivals.name: Hexentanz Walpurgisschlacht Festival
festivals.description: Three-day metal and rock festival at the historic Burg Lichtenberg castle near Kusel. A fixture of the German festival scene celebrating Walpurgis Night with heavy music.

festivals.name: Mayday
festivals.description: MAYDAY is Germany's largest indoor rave, dubbed the 'Mother of All Raves'. Since 1991, this legendary techno event transforms Westfalenhalle Dortmund into an 11-hour nonstop party across 4 floors with over 30 DJs and 15,000 ravers.

festivals.name: Rock am Kuhteich
festivals.description: Three-day punk and rock festival 'from fans for fans' at Kulturpark Deutzen between Leipzig and Chemnitz. 15th edition organized by Kulturdesign e.V. with camping available.

festivals.name: Internationales Bühler Bluegrass Festival
festivals.description: The most important bluegrass, folk, and Americana festival in the German-speaking region, now in its 22nd edition. Three days of banjo, fiddle, and mandolin from top US, Canadian, and European artists.
festivals.venue: Bürgerhaus Neuer Markt & St. Peter and Paul Church, Bühl

festivals.name: A Chance For Metal Festival
festivals.description: A Chance For Metal Festival celebrates 20 years of underground metal culture in Ochtendung. This authentic 'from fans for fans' event features rock and metal karaoke, 'best-of' bands from 20 years, and new acts in a non-commercial setting.

festivals.name: Tante Mia Tanzt Festival
festivals.description: Tante Mia Tanzt is Northwest Germany's largest EDM festival, held annually on Ascension Day at Stoppelmarkt Vechta. The ninth edition brings 30,000 fans together for 40+ acts across four stages spanning EDM, house, hardstyle, and techno.

festivals.name: Dark Troll Festival
festivals.description: Dark Troll Festival is a renowned pagan and black metal festival held at the atmospheric Schweinsburg castle ruins in Bornstedt, surrounded by thick Harz mountain woodlands. The magical setting creates an unforgettable underground metal experience.

festivals.name: Metal Power Open Air
festivals.description: Ultimate metal festival 'by metal fans for metal fans' at Eventarena Wittstock. Third edition featuring style variety from Thrash to Power to Black Metal with camping and parking available.

festivals.name: Rock In Rautheim
festivals.description: Rock in Rautheim is Germany's largest 'Inklusion-meets-Rock' festival, organized by Lebenshilfe Braunschweig since 2002. The two-day event brings together metal and rock fans while supporting people with disabilities.

festivals.name: Campus Festival Konstanz
festivals.description: Campus Festival Konstanz is a two-day indie festival directly at Lake Constance, celebrating its 11th edition. With 4 stages and up to 25,000 visitors, it offers hip-hop, indie, electronic, and genre mixes in a stunning lakeside setting.

festivals.name: Krankenschwester Rock(t) Festival
festivals.description: Open-air rock and punk festival since 2005 in Bad Wilsnack. Community-organized event with energetic rock and rousing punk in an intimate 500-person setting with camping.

festivals.name: Ladioo - Das Party Open Air
festivals.description: Ladioo is a party open air in Vechta offering 10 hours of live music with a colorful marathon from schlager hits to 90s/2000s classics. The event welcomes 8,000 party fans at Stoppelmarkt.

festivals.name: Trucker & Country Festival Deutschland
festivals.description: Trucker & Country Festival Geiselwind celebrates 45 years of Autohof history in 2026. Four days at Pentecost feature country music, beautiful trucks, a family program, and stars like TruckStop celebrating their 50th anniversary.

festivals.name: Ikarus Festival
festivals.description: Ikarus Festival transforms Allgäu Airport in Memmingen into Bavaria's largest electronic camping festival over Pentecost weekend. With over 150 acts across 8 stages, the former military airfield hosts techno, psytrance, house, and drum & bass in a unique aircraft hangar setting.

festivals.name: Wave-Gotik-Treffen
festivals.description: Wave-Gotik-Treffen is the world's largest gothic and dark culture festival, held annually during Whitsun in Leipzig. The 33rd edition features 150+ bands across 40+ venues throughout the city, plus medieval markets, film screenings, and the world's largest goth shopping market.

festivals.name: Modular Festival
festivals.description: Modular Festival transforms Gaswerk Augsburg into a colorful youth culture festival over three days. As Bavaria's largest non-commercial youth and pop culture festival, it features 50+ bands across three stages plus creative workshops and markets.

festivals.name: Wir leben laut Festival
festivals.description: Three-day rock and metal festival on the Festwiesen in Loburg, Saxony-Anhalt. Fourth edition featuring headliners Eisbrecher and Unantastbar with camping between Magdeburg and Berlin.

festivals.name: Festival ohne Bands
festivals.description: Unique concept festival offering the complete festival experience without actual bands. Features music, camping, festival food, Flunky Ball, crowdsurfing, and all the chaos - just no live acts.

festivals.name: HeideWitzka Festival
festivals.description: Electronic music festival celebrating its 11th anniversary with 10 stages and 100+ acts in the forest setting of Lange Heide. Four days of techno, hardstyle, and frenchcore near the Bavarian border.

festivals.name: Kleinfeldturnier Zernien Festival
festivals.description: Germany's largest small-field football tournament with WENDLAND BEATS Festival. Two nights of Malle party and EDM music plus 72 teams competing for 'German Championship of Bar Teams'.

festivals.name: RockArea A7 Open Air
festivals.description: Charity rock and metal festival donating proceeds to nonprofit organizations. 'Music For Charity' event by RockArea A7 e.V. featuring 3 days of rock and metal for a good cause.

festivals.name: R.O.I. Rock On Isens Festival
festivals.description: Fourth edition of international open-air in Isenser Wisch near Bremerhaven. Diverse lineup of pop, rock, and metal with unforgettable live performances in Butjadingen.

festivals.name: Wolfweez Open Air Festival
festivals.description: Two-day open-air festival in Irslingen featuring black metal, folk/viking/pagan, and thrash metal. A medium-sized gathering for extreme metal enthusiasts in Baden-Württemberg.

festivals.name: The Summerjam Festival
festivals.description: Summerjam is Europe's premier reggae, dancehall, and hip-hop festival, held at the scenic Fühlinger See lake in Cologne since 1986. The 39th edition continues the tradition with international reggae legends and new generation artists over three days.

festivals.name: Harry`s full Metal Party
festivals.description: Intimate metal party at sports ground in the Black Forest with camping, beach volleyball, bonfire, and Highlanderbar. Family-style atmosphere with chicken grill and traditional metal spirit.

festivals.name: Ruhrpott Rodeo
festivals.description: Ruhrpott Rodeo is Germany's largest punk rock festival, held at Flugplatz Schwarze Heide in Hünxe. Up to 12,000 punk fans gather for three days of punk rock, hip-hop, and ska, organized by drummer Alex Schwers of Slime fame.
festivals.venue: Flugplatz Schwarze Heide, Schwarze Heide 35, 46569 Hünxe

festivals.name: Orange Sun Festival
festivals.description: Psytrance and progressive electronic music festival in Mecklenburg featuring 4 floors of music. Intimate gathering focused on psychedelic sounds and community atmosphere.

festivals.name: In Flammen Open Air
festivals.description: In Flammen Open Air celebrates its 20th anniversary at the Entenfang venue in Torgau with three days of metal. Under the motto 'METAL IST FREIHEIT', this intimate death and extreme metal festival offers a passionate underground experience.

festivals.name: Wacken Open Air
festivals.description: Wacken Open Air is the world's most famous heavy metal festival, held annually in the small village of Wacken in Schleswig-Holstein. Since 1990, this pilgrimage for metalheads has grown to host 75,000+ fans over four days of legendary performances.

festivals.name: Happiness Festival
festivals.description: Happiness Festival is the largest music festival with camping in the Karlsruhe-Stuttgart region, held in Straubenhardt. The multi-day event focuses on hip-hop, indie-pop, and pop with national and international acts.

festivals.name: Bandlift - Festival
festivals.description: Largest free newcomer festival in Southern Germany with 10,000+ visitors. Four days featuring choir night, bands, and youth brass bands at the glider airfield in Gerstetten near Ulm.

festivals.name: Haune-Rock Festival
festivals.description: Haune-Rock is a regional rock festival in Haunetal near Fulda, featuring three days of rock and indie acts at the town's Festplatz. The intimate setting offers camping and an authentic local festival experience.

festivals.name: Dong Open Air
festivals.description: Dong Open Air is an intimate metal festival held on Halde Norddeutschland (Mount Moshmore) in Neukirchen-Vluyn. Around 4,000 metalheads enjoy 30 bands over three days in a family-like atmosphere with a spectacular hilltop location.

festivals.name: Rock for Animal Rights Festival
festivals.description: Vegan metal festival supporting animal rights since 2012. Organized by Tierrechtsbund Aktiv featuring 20+ bands, exclusively vegan food, and camping at the Tierrechtszentrum.

festivals.name: Match Börner Open Air
festivals.description: Biggest punk festival in Northern Germany celebrating its 5th anniversary. Over 7,000 visitors gather on the hillside meadow in Norderstedt city park, accessible by U-Bahn from Hamburg.

festivals.name: Rock und Metal Day'z
festivals.description: Cross-genre metal festival at a motorsport racetrack supporting children with cancer. Organized by MaDe for kids e.V. featuring 21+ bands across three days.

festivals.name: Pure Fucking Metal FestEvil
festivals.description: Small underground metal festival 'by fans for fans' in Bavaria. Non-profit event where all surplus is reinvested. Located between Landshut and Straubing with camping available.

festivals.name: Lautfeuer Festival
festivals.description: Free outdoor festival ('Umsonst & Draußen') in Lingen running since 1981. Features 10,000+ capacity, sustainable green hydrogen power supply, and past headliners like AnnenMayKantereit, Cro, and Kraftklub.

festivals.name: ROXSA Festival
festivals.description: Boutique Soul, Indie and Rock festival in the spa town of Bad Sülze. Maximum 2,500 guests for an intimate atmosphere with family-friendly programming and supervised children's activities.

festivals.name: Free For All Festival
festivals.description: One-day festival in East Frisia featuring punk, metal, hardcore and hip-hop. Known for bringing international acts and newcomers to Stapelmoorer Park in Weener.

festivals.name: Deichbrand Festival
festivals.description: Deichbrand is a major music festival near the North Sea coast, featuring around 100 bands and DJs across four days. From pop to rock, hip-hop to electro, this coastal festival at Cuxhaven-Nordholz airport draws 60,000 fans for a diverse musical experience.

festivals.name: Das Fest Karlsruhe
festivals.description: Das Fest is one of Germany's largest open-air festivals, celebrating its 40th anniversary in 2026. Held at Günther-Klotz-Anlage in Karlsruhe, it attracts up to 260,000 visitors with over 70% of the program accessible free of charge.

festivals.name: Jazzopen
festivals.description: jazzopen Stuttgart is one of Europe's leading jazz and beyond festivals, presenting international artists from jazz, blues, soul, and pop over 11 days at Schlossplatz. The 2026 edition features major headliners across 4 main stages attracting 50,000 visitors.

festivals.name: Baden in Blut Open Air
festivals.description: Baden in Blut is a two-day metal festival at DreiLänderGarten in Weil am Rhein near Basel. Since 2005, it has featured international metal acts from Satyricon to Paradise Lost in an intimate setting near the Swiss and French borders.
festivals.venue: DreiLänderGarten, Basler Str., 79576 Weil am Rhein

festivals.name: Open Air Weigendorf
festivals.description: 46th edition of this classic rock festival in the idyllic Lower Bavarian village of Weigendorf. Long-running tradition featuring rock and metal acts in a peaceful countryside setting.

festivals.name: Sea You Festival
festivals.description: Sea You Festival is an award-winning electronic music festival at Lake Tunisee near Freiburg. Over 15,000 fans from 35+ countries gather for techno and house at the scenic beach location, earning it recognition as one of the best festivals in Western Europe.

festivals.name: Zappanale Festival
festivals.description: Zappanale is the world's only Frank Zappa tribute festival, held at Europe's oldest racecourse in Bad Doberan near the Baltic Sea. The 35th edition features 20 bands over 4 days with former Zappa collaborators and jazz-rock-classical acts.

festivals.name: Rock im Garten
festivals.description: 13th edition of 'perhaps the most familiar festival in the world' in a garden in Rohrsheim. Volunteer-organized punk fest with bouncy castle, ball pit, and family program alongside bands like ZSK.
festivals.venue: Garten von Obi's Oma, Westentor 126a, 38836 Rohrsheim

festivals.name: Habitat Festival
festivals.description: Habitat Festival offers 32 hours of non-stop rave at MS Artville on Hamburg's Elbe island Wilhelmsburg. This two-day techno, electro, and house festival creates a collective escapism experience for over 8,000 electronic music enthusiasts.

festivals.name: Skalar Festival
festivals.description: Electronic music festival near Helenesee Lake in Germany, featuring immersive audiovisual experiences combining light art and electronic music.

festivals.name: M’era Luna Festival
festivals.description: M'era Luna is one of Germany's largest dark music festivals, held at a former British Army airbase near Hildesheim. With 20,000-25,000 attendees, the two-day event features gothic, metal, EBM, and synthpop across two stages plus workshops and side events.

festivals.name: Kopffrei Open Air
festivals.description: Expanding to two days for the first time in 2026. Features German rock, Gothic, Metal, and Medieval music at the Sportplatz in the Eichsfeld region of Thuringia since 2022.

festivals.name: Full Rewind Festival
festivals.description: Full Rewind Festival revives the spirit of the legendary WFF at its original venue in Roitzschjora. This hardcore-punk, metalcore, and death metal festival is organized 'from fans for fans' with a focus on authentic metal culture.

festivals.name: Firebirds Festival
festivals.description: Firebirds Festival is a Rock 'n' Roll and Rockabilly festival at the historic Kloster Nimbschen monastery near Grimma. The 14th edition celebrates 50s culture with concerts, dance courses, classic car meetups, and vintage fashion.

festivals.name: Elbenwald Festival
festivals.description: Elbenwald Festival transforms Spreeauenpark Cottbus into a paradise for fantasy, film, gaming, and cosplay fans. This unique mix of festival and convention features concerts, readings, workshops, and medieval camps over three days.

festivals.name: Mammut-Festival
festivals.description: Mammut Festival is a community-driven two-day indoor metal festival at MatriX Königsbrunn near Augsburg. Featuring 16 bands across all metal subgenres, it's organized by the scene itself for the Bavarian metal community.

festivals.name: Mittsommernächte Bärenstein
festivals.description: Three-day mystical open-air combining medieval markets, pagan rituals, and folk/metal music in the Erzgebirge. Fourth edition featuring camp life, historical crafts, and mead by fire.

festivals.name: Affenkäfig Festival
festivals.description: Three-day techno festival at Mendig airfield from the organizers behind quality techno raves since 2010. Over 50 top DJs playing day and night with 4 days of camping.
festivals.venue: Flugplatz Mendig, Am Alten Fort, 56743 Mendig

festivals.name: Stemweder Open Air
festivals.description: Stemweder Open Air is one of Germany's oldest free outdoor festivals, running since 1976 in Stemwede. With 12,000 visitors in the Ilweder Wäldchen forest, it offers rock, ska, alternative, and punk across three stages.

festivals.name: Angeliter Open Air
festivals.description: Two-day rock festival at a historic three-sided farmyard between North Sea and Baltic Sea. Known as 'the biggest garden party in Northern Germany' with family-friendly atmosphere since 2012.

festivals.name: Ewig Jung Festival
festivals.description: Large open-air featuring the best sounds of the 90s and 2000s with electronic music. Stars from three decades perform in the breathtaking expanses of Thüringer Eichsfeld since 2022.

festivals.name: Turnpike Reggae Festival
festivals.description: Two-day reggae festival in Lette blending roots and modern reggae. A welcoming gathering for reggae enthusiasts in the German countryside.

festivals.name: Mega Malle-Park-Festival
festivals.description: Germany's biggest Mallorca open-air festival transforming Elbauenpark into Playa de Palma atmosphere. Europe's longest Mallorca party featuring 20+ Schlager and party acts with cashless payment system.

festivals.name: Baltic Open Air
festivals.description: Baltic Open Air is a rock and metal festival held at Wikingerland Haddeby near Schleswig with a Viking theme. Three days of music across two open-air stages feature a mix of established and upcoming metal acts.

festivals.name: Wolfszeit Festival
festivals.description: Wolfszeit Festival is Germany's largest pagan and black metal open air, where vikings, pagans, and black metallers have gathered since 2007. The anniversary edition features a unique blend of pagan atmosphere, black metal intensity, and viking hymns.

festivals.name: Watt´n Country Festival
festivals.description: Four-day country music festival at the North Sea coast in Wangerland. Held at Jaderennbahn with diverse accommodation from camping to hotels in one of Germany's most popular vacation regions.

festivals.name: Save the Core Festival
festivals.description: One-day punk, metal, and hardcore festival in Nuremberg's Stadionpark. Third edition featuring Sex Pistols with Frank Carter headlining alongside Agnostic Front, Biohazard, and Walls of Jericho.

festivals.name: Shamrock Castle Festival
festivals.description: Shamrock Castle is a leading Celtic Rock and Folk festival in Germany, held at the historic Schloss Jägersburg in Franconian Switzerland. The 15th edition features Irish and Scottish folk rock acts in a castle setting with camping in the park.

festivals.name: Freak Valley Festival
festivals.description: Freak Valley is Europe's finest Heavy-Psych-Stoner-Blues-Doom-Punk-Fuzz Open Air, attracting fans from around the world to Netphen. The 13th edition features underground stoner and doom metal legends in an intimate 5,000-capacity setting.

festivals.name: Summer Breeze
festivals.description: Summer Breeze Open Air is one of Germany's largest metal festivals, held at an airfield near Dinkelsbühl in Bavaria since 1997. With 40,000 attendees and over 100 bands across four days, it's a pilgrimage for metal fans worldwide.

festivals.name: Reload Festival
festivals.description: Reload Festival is a major metal, hardcore, punk, and party festival in Sulingen near Bremen. The 2026 edition marks a record lineup with Judas Priest headlining for the first time alongside 50+ international metal acts.

festivals.name: Packhalle Open Air
festivals.description: Annual open-air at the Schützenplatz in Sögel where the town becomes a hotspot for music and festival magic. Growing in popularity with around 130 band applications received.

festivals.name: Die Festung Rockt
festivals.description: Die Festung Rockt celebrates 20 years in 2026 at the historic Festung Rosenberg in Kronach. The one-day punk and indie festival features 14 bands in a unique fortress setting, organized by local youth culture association.

festivals.name: Bluesfasching Apolda
festivals.description: Legendary blues and rock festival combined with carnival magic since 1986. Two nights of music, stories, and encounters at the unique Tiefgarage venue near Weimar.
festivals.venue: Tiefgarage Hotel am Schloß, Jenaer Straße 2, 99510 Apolda

festivals.name: The Rock House Festival
festivals.description: Two-day rock and metal festival near Bremerhaven featuring 15 bands across 2 stages. Located at The Rock House venue offering intimate shows in a dedicated rock establishment.

festivals.name: Camping Battleground Festival
festivals.description: Unique 4-day Pentecost metal festival with open infield where camping is part of the festival. Features 'Battlefield' for games and tournaments alongside rock, metal, and medieval music.

festivals.name: Taubertal Festival
festivals.description: Taubertal Festival celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2026, held at the historic Eiswiese venue surrounded by the medieval walls of Rothenburg ob der Tauber. The four-day event blends punk-rock, hip-hop, and alternative with a unique historical backdrop.

festivals.name: Lott Festival
festivals.description: Rock and alternative music festival in the scenic Hunsrück region. Offers a relaxed atmosphere with camping and diverse rock acts over three days.

festivals.name: Xperience Festival
festivals.description: Holistic wellness festival at Haus Yoga Vidya combining yoga, music, art, activism, and healing. All-inclusive plant-based catering, camping, and workshops in a conscious community setting.

festivals.name: Highfield Festival
festivals.description: Highfield is the largest independent rock festival in eastern Germany, set at the beautiful Störmthaler See lake near Leipzig. The three-day event offers rock, indie, and hip-hop with swimming and beach camping.

festivals.name: Open Flair Festival
festivals.description: Open Flair is a beloved indie and rock festival in Eschwege, running since 1985. The five-day event combines music, performing arts, and children's programs, attracting up to 20,000 visitors to the charming central German town.

festivals.name: Keep It True Festival
festivals.description: Keep It True is the traditional heavy metal festival celebrating classic metal, held at Tauber-Franken-Halle in Lauda-Königshofen. The 26th edition features cult acts like Venom and Magnum paying tribute to the late Tony Clarkin.

festivals.name: Internationales Dixieland Festival
festivals.description: The 54th Internationale Dixieland Festival is Germany's oldest and Europe's biggest traditional jazz festival. For one week, Dresden transforms into a swinging jazz stronghold with 42 bands from 10 nations and 250+ hours of music.

festivals.name: Rock den Acker Open Air
festivals.description: Small, cozy rock and metal festival in rural Nidderau-Erbstadt, 'the loudest village in Hesse'. Features free Family Day with children's activities and organized by nonprofit Rock den Acker e.V.

festivals.name: Hamburg Harley Days
festivals.description: Europe's largest biker city event with three days of Harley culture, live rock and blues music, and the grand Sunday parade of rumbling Harleys through Hamburg's iconic landmarks.

festivals.name: Immergut Festival
festivals.description: Immergut Festival is one of Germany's largest indie rock festivals, held in the Mecklenburg Lake District since 2000. The 26th edition offers three days of music, lake swimming, and celebrating friendships in nature.

festivals.name: Schamanisches Festival
festivals.description: Spiritual gathering around summer solstice in the Eifel region featuring workshops on shamanic practices, healing ceremonies, and nature connection rituals.

festivals.name: Tropical Mountain Festival
festivals.description: Electronic music meets vacation vibes in Saarland as the Alm transforms into a tropical festival world. Spectacular stage, light show, and unique atmosphere on Pentecost Saturday.

festivals.name: Apen Air Festival
festivals.description: Punk festival celebrating its 10th edition in 2026 near Oldenburg and Bremen. Features a strong lineup of German and international punk acts in an intimate 2,500 capacity setting.

festivals.name: La Fiesta Festival (Saarland)
festivals.description: The biggest party in Saarland at 'die Alm im Erlebnisort Reden' featuring Germany's famous Mallorca and party acts. One-day summer celebration with VIP options and shuttle service.

festivals.name: Iron Fest Open Air
festivals.description: Epic three-day heavy metal festival at picturesque Ohmbachsee featuring 20+ bands. Known for classic and traditional metal acts in scenic lakeside setting between Schönenberg-Kübelberg and Gries.

festivals.name: M.I.S.E. Open Air
festivals.description: Three-day metal festival organized by Heavy Metal Club M.I.S.E. promoting non-political multicultural rock and metal since 2012. Fair prices, good sound, and cozy atmosphere at Grillhütte Büßfeld.

festivals.name: Wudzdog Open Air
festivals.description: Genre-crossing festival inspired by hippie culture and Woodstock spirit since 2000. Organized by 'Die Waldgeister' in Bavaria with a focus on musical diversity for all.

festivals.name: Zurück zu den Wurzeln Festival
festivals.description: Participatory electronic culture festival embracing Berlin's party spirit with 200+ DJs. Features techno, psytrance, ambient and more plus workshops, theater, cinema, and art in a sustainable setting.

festivals.name: Between the Seas Festival
festivals.description: Three-day EDM highlight in Schleswig-Holstein featuring 4 stages with top electronic acts. Camping available at the Geestland-Eventgelände in Kropp.

festivals.name: Hussitenfest Bernau
festivals.description: Largest city festival in the region celebrating Bernau's 1432 defense against Hussite invaders. Medieval market, knight battles, fire shows, army camps, and grand parade with 1,000+ participants.
festivals.venue: Historic city center, Bernau bei Berlin

festivals.name: High Flames Festival
festivals.description: Three-day rock and metal festival expanding in 2026 with new Thursday edition. Located in scenic Lower Saxony countryside near Sulingen with camping available.

festivals.name: Docklands Festival
festivals.description: Docklands Festival transforms Münster into Germany's house and techno capital for one day. Since 2010, the event has grown to welcome 15,000 fans from 20+ nations with 70+ acts across four open-air stages.

festivals.name: Godless Mountain Open Air
festivals.description: Two-day underground metal festival promoting newcomer and emerging bands for over a decade. Features workshops on music production and instrument maintenance at Commerau venue.

festivals.name: Traumzeit Festival
festivals.description: Traumzeit Festival is one of Europe's most extraordinary festivals, held in the stunning industrial landscape of Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord. Three days of indie-rock, post-punk, folk, and electronic music unfold among illuminated steel constructions and chimneys.

festivals.name: Heroes Festival Geiselwind
festivals.description: Heroes Festival brings German hip-hop directly to fans at Eventzentrum Geiselwind. The two-day event features top German rap artists including Bonez MC, RIN, SSIO, and Kool Savas.

festivals.name: JazzBaltica
festivals.description: JazzBaltica is an intimate jazz festival at the Maritim Seehotel on the Baltic Sea coast. The four-day event features concerts in Timmendorfer Strand with 21 free outdoor concerts plus ticketed performances.

festivals.name: Electrifinity Festival
festivals.description: Underground techno and electronic festival in Bad Aibling known for its 'no VIPs, no main stage' philosophy. Three days of equality-focused dancing and genuine community spirit.

festivals.name: Let The Bad Times Roll Open Air
festivals.description: 18th edition of volunteer-organized rock festival near the sea in East Frisia. Two stages featuring regional, national, and international rock, punk, and metal acts on last June weekend.

festivals.name: Vainstream Rockfest
festivals.description: Vainstream Rockfest celebrates its 20th anniversary in Münster's Am Hawerkamp district. The two-day punk and rock festival features Rise Against, Social Distortion, and Architects headlining for passionate fans in the heart of the city.

festivals.name: Kessel Festival
festivals.description: Kessel Festival transforms Stuttgart's Cannstatter Wasen into a unique music, culture, and sustainability festival. Seven stages, local talent, sports activities, and innovative sustainability ideas create a vibrant weekend experience.

festivals.name: Kindheitstraum Festival
festivals.description: Electronic music open-air at the airfield near Speichersdorf, Bayreuth. One-day event featuring 16 DJs across two dance floors with closing fireworks, attracting 6,000+ visitors.

festivals.name: Hörnerfest
festivals.description: Hörnerfest celebrates its 20th edition in 2026, offering a unique mix of metal, folk, medieval rock, pirate metal, and Celtic sounds. The three-day festival near Hamburg features Die Apokalyptischen Reiter and underground folk metal acts.

festivals.name: Rock For Tolerance Open Air
festivals.description: 10th anniversary celebration promoting tolerance through music and charity. Two days, two stages featuring punk to metal, with free entry for under-16s and over-65s. Has raised 95,000€ for social projects since 2016.

festivals.name: Bochum Total
festivals.description: Bochum Total is one of Europe's largest free inner-city music festivals, held in the famous Bermudadreieck entertainment quarter since 1986. Six stages and 117 acts deliver rock, pop, indie, electronic, and hip-hop over four days.

festivals.name: Rudolstadt Festival
festivals.description: Rudolstadt Festival is Germany's largest folk, roots, and world music festival, running since 1955. The 34th modern edition features 300 events across 20+ stages with Austria as the 2026 country focus and artists from 30+ nations.

festivals.name: Ruhr Reggae Summer Festival
festivals.description: Ruhr Reggae Summer is a three-day reggae and dancehall festival at Naturbad Styrum in Mülheim an der Ruhr. Since 2007, it has brought Caribbean vibes to the Ruhr area with international reggae artists.
festivals.venue: Naturbad Styrum, Friesenstrasse 101, 45476 Mülheim an der Ruhr

festivals.name: Green Juice Festival
festivals.description: Green Juice Festival brings the best indie, pop, and rock acts to Bonn since 2008. Two days at Park-Neu-Vilich feature three stages, 7,500 daily visitors, and a camping area with a community atmosphere.

festivals.name: Burning Q Festival
festivals.description: Three-day metal festival near Bremen covering every subgenre from Heavy to Brutal Death. Organized by nonprofit promoting metal in Northern Germany. Known for selling out weeks in advance.

festivals.name: Schlagermove Hamburg
festivals.description: Schlagermove is the world's largest open-air Schlager parade, transforming Hamburg into a colorful celebration since 1997. Around 50 decorated trucks with DJs and Schlager artists parade through St. Pauli, attracting over 400,000 visitors dressed in 70s costumes for a weekend of 'colorful, peaceful, cheerful' festivities.

festivals.name: Folkfield Festival
festivals.description: Folkfield Festival is a folk, medieval rock, and metal celebration created by the band Schandmaul, established in 2022 at the Amphitheater Gelsenkirchen. The two-day event unites the folk and medieval music community with acts ranging from Celtic speedfolk to dark romanticism.

festivals.name: Tanz der Bässe Festival
festivals.description: Tanz der Bässe is an electronic beach festival held at Badesee Lampertheim since 2011. The event combines techno and house music with a relaxed lakeside atmosphere, offering swimming and dancing opportunities at this unique venue near Mannheim.

festivals.name: Field Invasion Festival
festivals.description: Field Invasion Festival is a familial, cozy metal open-air founded in the idyllic Westerwald region, emphasizing community and support for regional bands. Over 600 metal enthusiasts gather at the Müllerhof venue for three days of underground metal with fire barrels and attention to detail.

festivals.name: Feel Festival
festivals.description: Feel Festival is a genre-spanning celebration at Bergheider See since 2013, known as a Berlin summer insider tip. With 16 stages and 20,000 attendees, it combines electronic music, indie, hip-hop, and art installations in a unique lakeside setting near Cottbus.

festivals.name: Tanzinsel Open Air
festivals.description: Major electronic festival on the Main river attracting 10,000 visitors. Festival stage surrounded by water on three sides with international DJs from 10am to 10pm, ending with grand fireworks.

festivals.name: KP-ONE Festival
festivals.description: KP-ONE Festival is a multi-genre celebration at a former asphalt mixing plant in Wolfsburg-Neindorf. The three-day event combines Friday's electronic club night with Saturday's Schlager party and Sunday's family-friendly festival, offering a unique blend of music styles.

festivals.name: Strandgut Festival
festivals.description: Strandgut Elektrofestival brings electronic music directly to the sandy beaches of the Baltic Sea in Eckernförde. Since 2023, 8,000 fans dance in chalk-white sand to house and pop artists with a touch of Ibiza atmosphere at this unique coastal venue.

festivals.name: Taunus Metal Festival
festivals.description: Taunus Metal Festival is a non-profit organized metal event in Oberursel, giving local bands and the underground scene a platform since its inception. The 16th edition features 18 bands over two days at the Burgwiesenhalle, showcasing traditional and extreme metal.

festivals.name: Hell over Halen Festival
festivals.description: Hell over Halen is a metal festival in Emstek, Germany, organized by dedicated metalheads to bring underground and international metal acts to the region. The intimate open-air event offers authentic heavy metal atmosphere in a community setting.

festivals.name: Hai in den Mai Festival
festivals.description: Annual psytrance season opener at magical Waldfrieden forest venue. Four floors from driving beats to experimental sounds, plus yoga, healing workshops, vegan food, and art in eco-conscious setting.

festivals.name: Besser als nix Festival
festivals.description: Free 3-day festival on the Rhine meadows with 12,000 visitors. 14th edition featuring newcomers and established bands on two stages, organized by volunteer association for young culture in Rheingau.

festivals.name: Weser Metal Meeting
festivals.description: Weser Metal Meeting is organized by Metal Crew Reinhardshagen e.V. to bring live metal to fans in the countryside without traveling to big cities. The eighth edition at Wesertalhalle provides a large stage for underground and established metal acts alike.

festivals.name: Desertfest
festivals.description: Desertfest Berlin is Europe's reference address for stoner rock, doom, psychedelic, and heavy instrumentals. Since 2012, the festival has transformed Columbiahalle and Columbia Theater into a heavy riff sanctuary, featuring international headliners and underground legends.

festivals.name: Metalheadz Open Air
festivals.description: Metalheadz Open Air is organized by Bavarian Metalheadz HMF e.V., celebrating its 14th edition in 2026. This Bavarian metal festival offers an intimate setting for rock and metal bands in the picturesque countryside of Oberndorf am Lech.

festivals.name: Der Detze Rockt
festivals.description: 14th edition of metal open-air in the Eifel ranked among Top 10 German festivals. Nonprofit organization donating to children's hospices and ALS research while promoting newcomer artists.

festivals.name: SonneMondSterne Festival
festivals.description: SonneMondSterne (SMS) is one of Germany's largest electronic music festivals, transforming the shores of Bleiloch reservoir near Saalburg into a vibrant playground since 1997. Around 40,000 visitors enjoy big-room EDM, house, and techno from sunset to sunrise across multiple themed stages.

festivals.name: Bavarian Battle Open Air
festivals.description: Bavarian Battle Open Air celebrates its 13th edition in 2026, drawing metal fans to the Rosenheim area for an authentic old-school metal experience. The festival features a Biergarten, traditional Weißwurstfrühstück, and Meet & Greets with international metal bands.

festivals.name: Rock Hard Festival
festivals.description: Rock Hard Festival is a family-friendly hard rock and metal festival at the Amphitheater Gelsenkirchen on the Rhein-Herne-Kanal. Since 2006, the Pentecost weekend event has featured classic heavy metal and thrash acts with a maximum capacity of 7,000 attendees.

festivals.name: Rock The Hill Festival
festivals.description: Unique music and MTB festival at Geisskopf in the Bavarian Forest. Four days combining punk, rock bands with mountain biking, expo area, and camping since 2010.

festivals.name: Sputnik Spring Break Festival
festivals.description: Sputnik Spring Break is presented by MDR Sputnik radio, held each Pentecost on the idyllic Pouch Peninsula at Goitschesee. The festival brings together 25,000 fans for hip-hop, techno, and rap acts on the shores of a former open-pit mining lake near Leipzig.

festivals.name: Rage Against Racism Open Air
festivals.description: Rage Against Racism is a free metal and rock festival in Duisburg since 2003, connected with open children and youth work in the district. Around 3,000 visitors gather at Friemersheimer Mühle for two days of metal, punk, and rock celebrating diversity and unity.

festivals.name: Stove Open Air
festivals.description: 9th edition promoting German-speaking newcomer musicians. Organized by deutschFM radio and volunteer association with surpluses donated to charity.

festivals.name: Aaargh Festival
festivals.description: 20th anniversary edition (2006-2026) of gothic and doom metal festival in the Allgäu. 22 bands across 3 days amidst green meadows and rural idyll at Caspershof.

festivals.name: Rock Am Härtsfeldsee Festival
festivals.description: 26th edition of metal and gothic rock festival at the scenic Härtsfeldsee since 1997. Organized by Jugend Dischingen e.V. with 4,000 capacity, has hosted Accept, Arch Enemy, and Powerwolf.

festivals.name: Feuertanz Festival
festivals.description: Feuertanz Festival has been held at the historic Burg Abenberg near Nürnberg since 2001, combining medieval rock and folk with a market, fire acrobatics, jesters, and knight's dinner. The two-day event transforms the castle grounds into a time-traveling celebration for 5,000 fans.

festivals.name: Medival Open Air
festivals.description: 11th anniversary of electronic music at medieval castle ruins. Symbiosis of classical ambience and modern House, Techno, Trance, and Drum & Bass on four stages with creative workshops.
festivals.venue: Festwiese Burgruine Brandenburg, 99834 Gerstungen OT Lauchröden

festivals.name: Latin Airport Festival
festivals.description: Germany's biggest Latin open-air festival at Nuremberg Airport since 2018. International and national live acts on July 4th with cashless payment and included aftershow parties.

festivals.name: Boarstream Open Air
festivals.description: Boarstream Open Air is organized 'Von Metalheads für Metalheads' (from metalheads for metalheads) since 2008 in Buchenbach. With a maximum of 666 tickets, this intimate festival creates a familiar atmosphere for fans of black, death, and heavy metal from across Europe.

festivals.name: Amphi Festival
festivals.description: Amphi Festival celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026 at Tanzbrunnen Köln, the premier gathering for Germany's 'Schwarze Szene' (dark scene). The two-day event features goth, industrial, EBM, synthpop, and darkwave acts on both open-air and indoor stages along the Rhine.

festivals.name: Afdreiht & Buten Festival
festivals.description: Punk and hardcore festival at Hartensbergsee offering moshpit, lake swimming, and loud guitars. Two stages with camping at your car in the heart of Northern Germany.

festivals.name: Ferdinands Feld Festival
festivals.description: Ferdinands Feld is an electronic music festival at Flugplatz Rotenburg (Wümme) since 2015. Named after Ferdinand von Zeppelin, the festival brings 15,000 fans together for techno, hardstyle, and house across five stages on a scenic airfield near Bremen and Hamburg.

festivals.name: Rock den Lukas Festival
festivals.description: Over 20 years of village festival grown into regional favorite in the Elbe-Weser region. 2026 headlined by Fun-Metal-Band J.B.O. with rock, punk, and ska.

festivals.name: Sticky Fingers Festival
festivals.description: Long-running metal, hardcore and punk festival since 1988 at Weidersberg recreation area. Has hosted Napalm Death, Sepultura, and Sick Of It All over the decades.

festivals.name: MS Dockville
festivals.description: MS Dockville is Hamburg's beloved festival for music and art since 2007, drawing 60,000 visitors to Wilhelmsburg harbor area. The two-day event features 100+ acts across 10 stages alongside 150+ art installations, workshops, and creative experiences right by the Elbe river.

festivals.name: Hoflärm Open Air
festivals.description: Three-day stoner rock, doom, and psychedelic festival at historic farmhouse. Features Kadavar, Kylesa, and Midnight's special anniversary performance of Satanic Royalty.

festivals.name: Rock Am Wald Festival Nordbaden
festivals.description: The festival highlight in Nordbaden since 2002. Three days of country, funk, rock, and tribute acts with Thursday open night DJ set in Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen.

festivals.name: Finkenbach Festival
festivals.description: Finkenbach Festival, known as 'Woodstock of the Odenwald,' has been a cult gathering since 1976 at the Finkenbacher Sportplatz. The two-day celebration of krautrock, rock, and folk features ten bands in an authentic, intimate setting with camping included in the ticket price.

festivals.name: Party.San Open Air
festivals.description: Party.San Metal Open Air celebrates its 30th edition in 2026 at Obermehler airfield near Schlotheim. With two stages, around 10,000 metalheads, and a lineup spanning thrash, death, black, and doom metal, it remains one of Germany's most respected underground metal festivals.

festivals.name: Echelon Open Air & Indoor Festival
festivals.description: Echelon Festival transforms a former NSA listening base in Bad Aibling into southern Germany's largest open-air techno event since 2010. Five impressive stages beneath the iconic listening domes deliver techno, house, trance, and hardstyle against the Bavarian Alps backdrop.

festivals.name: Trveheim Festival
festivals.description: Traditional heavy metal festival celebrating NWOBHM heroes and underground spirit since 2016. Vol. 9 at Hausler Hof near Munich with Bavarian beer garden hospitality and proper facilities.

festivals.name: Holter Meeting Festival
festivals.description: Free outdoor festival ('Umsonst und Draussen') on the last August weekend. 15 bands perform behind the swimming pool in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock with camping available.
festivals.venue: Auf der Wiese am Hallenbad, 33758 Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock

festivals.name: Klangtherapie Festival
festivals.description: Klangtherapie Festival has transformed a field in Franconian Switzerland into a playground of possibilities for 22 years. The five-stage event combines electronic music with wellness workshops, yoga, lectures, and performances in an alternative, non-commercial atmosphere.

festivals.name: Reggae Jam
festivals.description: Reggae Jam has been Germany's premier reggae festival since 1994, voted best reggae festival eight consecutive years by Riddim magazine readers. The three-day celebration at Klosterpark Bersenbrück brings international reggae, dancehall, and dub artists to the scenic venue near Osnabrück.

festivals.name: Brass Wiesn Festival
festivals.description: Brass Wiesn Festival merges traditional Bavarian Blasmusik with modern beats since 2013 at Echinger See near Munich. Four days of brass bands, beer gardens, alpine huts, and a swimming lake create a unique celebration where dirndls meet rock guitars.

festivals.name: Masters of the Unicorn Open Air
Ruhr in Love
festivals.description: Ruhr in Love is an annual electronic music family festival in Oberhausen since 2003, featuring 30 colorful floors with 300 DJs at the former mining site OlgaPark. Around 35,000 ravers celebrate all facets of electronic music from techno and house to hardcore and goa.

festivals.name: Orange Blossom Special Festival
festivals.description: Orange Blossom Special is acclaimed as 'the best small festival in the world' by Rolling Stone, held annually in the Glitterhouse Garten since 1996. Limited to 3,000 attendees, the intimate three-day indie celebration in Beverungen has become a renowned gathering for quality music lovers.

festivals.name: Schlossgrabenfest
festivals.description: Schlossgrabenfest is one of Germany's biggest free open-air festivals, drawing over 100,000 visitors to Darmstadt's city center each Pentecost since 2001. The four-day celebration features 60+ bands and 12 DJs across 3 stages with pure genre diversity from rock to techno.

festivals.name: moers Festival
festivals.description: Moers Festival is one of Europe's leading festivals of jazz and contemporary improvised music since 1971. The 55th edition brings avant-garde musicians, world music, and experimental performances to the Lower Rhine, known for its willingness to take risks and explore new territory.
lineup: Gordon Grdina's RU'YA feat. Ghalia Benali

festivals.name: NDR 2 Plaza Festival
festivals.description: NDR 2 Plaza Festival brings international pop and rock stars to Hannover's EXPO Plaza for one spectacular day. The radio station-backed event features a mix of German stars and international acts performing for thousands of fans in the former World Expo grounds.

festivals.name: Chronical Moshers Open Air
festivals.description: Chronical Moshers Open Air is a renowned metal festival in Saxony since 2003, drawing metalheads from around the world to Hirschfeld/Hauptmannsgrün. The three-day event features black, death, thrash, and pagan metal across 19 editions with 164 artists to date.
festivals.venue: Chronical Moshers e.V., Irfersgrüner Straße 12, 08468 Hauptmannsgrün

festivals.name: This is Ska Festival
festivals.description: This Is Ska Festival celebrates all waves of ska music at the picturesque Wasserburg Roßlau since 2006. The three-day gathering at the historic water castle offers a balanced mix from traditional ska to 2-Tone to 3rd-Wave in a relaxed, non-commercial atmosphere.

festivals.name: OBEN OHNE Open Air
festivals.description: OBEN OHNE Open Air is southern Germany's largest non-commercial festival, held at Munich's iconic Königsplatz since 1998. The youth-focused celebration offers indie, hip-hop, and electronic music for 20,000 attendees aged 12+, with solidarity tickets for low-income youth.

festivals.name: Singoldsand Festival
festivals.description: Singoldsand Festival is an award-winning volunteer-run youth and pop culture event in Schwabmünchen, named Festival of the Year at [pop]award Bayern 2025. The two-day beach-themed celebration on the Singold river banks has grown to 10,000 guests since its founding in 2011.

festivals.name: Under The Black Sun Festival
festivals.description: Under The Black Sun has been a mainstay of the extreme metal scene since 1995 at Freilichtbühne Friesack. The 27th edition features black metal, death metal, doom, and grindcore with no filler bands and ample performance time for each act.

festivals.name: About You Pangea Festival
festivals.description: About You Pangea Festival is a multi-genre lakeside weekender at an ex-military airbase in Pütnitz since 2012. The four-day event mixes indie, hip-hop, and electronic music with over 100 workshops, wakeboarding, windsurfing, and playful activities for 20,000 attendees.

festivals.name: Reeperbahn Festival
festivals.description: Reeperbahn Festival is Europe's largest club festival, transforming Hamburg's St. Pauli district into a hub of music, art, and industry each September since 2006. Over 600 events across 80+ venues showcase emerging talent, while 5,000 music professionals attend the parallel conference.

festivals.name: Fusion Festival
festivals.description: Fusion Festival is a legendary music and arts gathering at a former military airport in Lärz since 1997, organized as 'Holiday Communism' by Kulturkosmos. Five days of techno, psytrance, house, theater, film, and art installations attract devoted fans to this countercultural celebration.

festivals.name: Norden Festival
festivals.description: NORDEN - The Nordic Arts Festival spans three weekends at the Ostseefjord Schlei since 2018, winning the 'Greenest Festival' Helga! Award in 2023. The sustainable cultural celebration offers pop music, street theater, literature, film, and DIY courses with a family-friendly, affordable approach.

festivals.name: Appletree Garden Festival
festivals.description: Appletree Garden celebrates its 25th anniversary in 2026 at Bürgerpark Diepholz, offering indie, pop, and electro between forest floor and fragrant apple trees since 2001. Limited to 5,000 attendees, the eco-conscious festival features circus, discourse, and workshops alongside music.

festivals.name: Headbangers Open Air
festivals.description: Headbangers Open Air is 'the biggest garden party of the world,' held on a restored farm yard near Hamburg since 1996. The intimate classic metal festival for 2,000 fans features legends of the 80s and 90s alongside underground bands in a familial atmosphere.

festivals.name: Rocken am Brocken Festival
festivals.description: Rocken am Brocken brings music and nature together in the Harz mountains since 2007, with the unique option of arriving by historic steam train. The genre-crossing festival in Elend features indie, hip-hop, techno, and an 'Akustikpfad' acoustic hike through stunning Brocken scenery.

festivals.name: Storm Crusher Festival
festivals.description: Storm Crusher Festival is a two-day old school heavy metal celebration in the northern Upper Palatinate since its founding. Limited to 1,000 attendees at Wurzer Oschnitt-Halle, it features heavy, power, thrash, doom, and epic metal in an intimate underground setting.

festivals.name: Full Metal Cruise
festivals.description: Full Metal Cruise XIII is a metal music cruise aboard TUI's Mein Schiff 6, sailing the Mediterranean with world-class concerts, extreme sports, and tattoo workshops. The two-part voyage departs from Palma de Mallorca to Barcelona, Marseille, Palermo, and Cagliari.

festivals.name: Breminale
festivals.description: Breminale is Bremen's beloved free culture festival along the Weser river since 1987, drawing 220,000 visitors under the motto 'Kultur für alle.' The five-day celebration offers live music across 9 stages plus art, theater, children's programs, and dance from noon until night.

festivals.name: Sound of the Forest Festival
festivals.description: Sound of the Forest celebrates its 15th anniversary in 2026 at the Marbachstausee in the Odenwald. The intimate multi-genre festival features handpicked indie, electro, pop, and rock acts alongside workshops, nature experiences, readings, and art in the forest.

festivals.name: Kleines Fest im Großen Garten
festivals.description: Kleines Fest im Großen Garten transforms Hannover's Herrenhausen Gardens into a magical world of street theater, acrobatics, comedy, and music over 13 evenings each July. Up to 100 international artists perform under the 2026 motto 'Schön hier' with a new Family Day.

festivals.name: Isle of Summer
festivals.description: Isle of Summer is Munich's premier electronic open-air series since 2011, with the flagship Festival at Olympia Reitanlage Riem featuring four stages and over 20 international DJs. The 2026 season includes Opening, Festival, and Beach events throughout summer.

festivals.name: Syndicate Festival
festivals.description: Syndicate is Germany's biggest harder styles event, bringing 15,000 fans to Dortmund's Westfalenhallen each year on German Unity Day. Over 40 acts across 4 floors deliver hardcore, hardstyle, and uptempo from 8 PM until 6 AM.

festivals.name: Festival-Mediaval
festivals.description: Festival-Mediaval is one of Europe's most prominent medieval-themed festivals at Goldberg in Selb. The 2026 'Legends Special' features In Extremo's 30th anniversary show, Corvus Corax with orchestra, and Subway to Sally alongside markets, reenactments, and medieval cuisine.

festivals.name: Open Beatz Festival
festivals.description: Open Beatz celebrates its 11th anniversary in 2026 as one of southern Germany's largest electronic festivals. Seven stages across 50 hectares near Nuremberg deliver EDM, techno, house, hardstyle, and psytrance for over 20,000 visitors.

festivals.name: Detect Classic Festival
festivals.description: Detect Classic Festival blurs boundaries between club, open air, and concert hall at 800-year-old Schloss Bröllin. Three days of contemporary classical, experimental, electronic, and improvised music create one of Europe's most distinctive events.

festivals.name: IN.DIE.musik Festival
festivals.venue: Parkplatz Freiheitshalle HofKulmbacher Str. 4, 95030 Hof, Freiheitshalle ParkplatzHof,DE95030

festivals.name: Countryfest Eichelsdorf
festivals.venue: Gelände des Alexander von Humboldt GymnasiumHaßbergstraßeEichelsdorf,DE97461

festivals.name: Streetz Open Air ST.O.A.
festivals.venue: Home of St.O.A. (alte Sandkuhle)Kastanienalle, direkt Ortseingang linksStreetz,DE29451

festivals.name: Mind On Fire Festival
festivals.description: Mind On Fire is 'Das Kulturfestival der Seele' in the idyllic Schlosspark Schlitz, featuring over 25 international bands alongside art and workshops. The family-friendly four-day event offers yoga, crafting, and performances for all ages.

festivals.name: Pop-Kultur
festivals.description: Pop-Kultur transforms Berlin's Kulturbrauerei into a hub of popular music, art, and societal dialogue each August since 2015. The six-day festival features concerts, DJ sets, commissioned works, talks, and workshops highlighting underrepresented voices.

festivals.name: Lollapalooza Deutschland
festivals.description: Lollapalooza Berlin brings the legendary American festival brand to Olympic Park since 2015, now drawing over 70,000 attendees. The two-day celebration features international pop, rock, and electronic headliners alongside emerging artists.

festivals.name: Elbriot Festival
festivals.description: Elbriot transforms Hamburg's Wholesale Market grounds into the city's premier metal and rock festival each summer. The 2026 edition features power-metal titans Powerwolf, prog legends Savatage, and deathcore heavyweights Thy Art Is Murder.

festivals.name: Wilde Möhre Festival
festivals.description: Wilde Möhre is an eclectic festival at Gräbendorfer See since 2014, known for strong community and thoughtful programming. Electronic music sits at the core alongside bands, theater, literature, and environmental talks near the German-Polish border.

festivals.name: Nig Rock Festival
festivals.venue: Rasengelände des Niedersächsichen InternatsgymnasiumsSeminarstr. 8Geestland - Bad Bederkesa,DE27624

festivals.name: Knock Out Festival
festivals.description: Knock Out Festival is Germany's largest indoor rock festival, bringing metal and hard rock to Karlsruhe's Schwarzwaldhalle each December. The one-day event features established acts alongside rising stars of the heavy music scene.

festivals.name: Euroblast Festival
festivals.description: Euroblast Festival celebrates its 20th anniversary in 2026 as the premier gathering for progressive and avant-garde metal at Essigfabrik Köln. The three-day event has helped shape the modern djent and prog scene, hosting bands from over 45 countries since 2008.

festivals.name: Metal Hammer Paradise
festivals.description: Metal Hammer Paradise transforms the Weissenhäuser Strand resort into a metal haven each November since 2012. The indoor festival offers multiple stages plus access to the Subtropical Aqua Park and rooftop sauna between sets.

festivals.name: Hive Festival
festivals.description: HIVE Festival transforms Ferropolis, the 'City of Iron,' into a mechanized electronic dreamscape for over 20,000 devotees. Seven themed arenas including Techno Castle, Groove Beach, and Psy Lagoon deliver techno, trance, and hardstyle beneath industrial giants.

festivals.name: Tag am Meer Festival
festivals.description: Tag am Meer Festival brings techno, house, and reggae to the historic beach of Prora on Rügen since 2013. The intimate 2,000-capacity event offers breathtaking Baltic Sea views with beats, adding a peaceful chapter to the site's unique history.

festivals.name: Open Ohr Festival
festivals.description: Open Ohr Festival is Germany's unique cultural-political youth festival at Mainz Citadel since 1975. The 52nd edition addresses 'ALLEINSAM' (loneliness) through music, theater, workshops, and discussion forums for 9,000-11,000 visitors during Pentecost.

festivals.name: Midsummer Bulli Festival
festivals.description: Midsummer Bulli Festival celebrates the longest days of the year with 1,200+ VW Bullis on Fehmarn's Südstrand since its inception. The four-day gathering features a legendary Bulli convoy, live music, Show-and-Shine competitions, and Midsummer pole dancing.

festivals.name: 3000 Grad Festival
festivals.description: 3000 Grad Festival creates a second home for 3,000 nature-loving electronic music fans at the Feldberger Seenlandschaft. The festival blends techno, house, and world music with stunning lakeside sunsets and the beauty of northern Germany's summer.

festivals.name: Voov Experience Festival
festivals.description: VooV Experience is 'the mother of all Goa festivals,' born in 1991 and credited with spreading psytrance throughout Europe. Over 20,000 visitors gather at the 'Field of Joy' near Putlitz for four days of progressive, full-on, and dark psy under legendary laser shows.

festivals.name: Stoned from the Underground Festival
festivals.description: Stoned from the Underground is one of the longest-standing stoner festivals in the scene, held at Alperstedter See near Erfurt since 2001. The three-day celebration of stoner, doom, sludge, and psychedelic rock draws devoted fans to Thuringia each July.

festivals.name: Glaubitz Open Air / Back to Future Festival
Electrisize Festival
festivals.description: Electrisize celebrates 17 years transforming historic monastery Haus Hohenbusch into one of Germany's most diverse summer hotspots. Three days welcome up to 55,000 visitors for EDM, hardstyle, and live acts plus beer yoga, shuffle workshops, and a giant Ferris wheel.

festivals.name: Bucht der Träumer* Festival
festivals.description: Bucht der Träumer is organized by Berlin's Rebellion der Träumer collective at Helenesee near Frankfurt (Oder). The five-day electronic gathering emphasizes sustainability with Bassliner shuttles and bike travel encouraged.

festivals.name: Glücksgefühle Festival
festivals.description: Glücksgefühle Festival is Germany's biggest music festival, transforming Hockenheimring into 'the happiest place in the world' for over 250,000 visitors. Curated by Lukas Podolski, the four-day event features 50+ top acts across three stages spanning hip-hop, pop, and EDM.

festivals.name: Beer Now Open Festival
festivals.venue: Gelände der Kreisverkehrswacht BarnimMarie-Curie-Straße 15Bernau bei Berlin,DE16321

festivals.name: Das Grosse Treffen - Fantasy Festival
festivals.description: Das Grosse Treffen is one of Germany's largest fantasy festivals at Mega Eventpark Aach near Lake Constance. The three-day celebration unites Medieval, Gothic, Steampunk, Post-Apocalyptic, Fantasy, and LARP communities with bands, markets, dragons, and a Lightsaber Championship.
festivals.venue: Mega Eventpark Aach, Singener Straße 22, 78267 Aach

festivals.name: Open Air am See - Dürener Badesee
St. Katharina Open Air
festivals.description: St. Katharina Open Air has enchanted audiences in Nuremberg's historic church ruins since 1992, known for excellent acoustics in the 13th-century abbey courtyard. The multi-week festival presents diverse genres from blues to rock to hip-hop, drawing 8,000 visitors annually.

festivals.name: Internationales Jazzfestival Unterföhring
festivals.city: München Bürgerhaus Unterföhring bei München Münchner Straße
festivals.venue: Bürgerhaus Unterföhring bei MünchenMünchner Straße 65Unterföhring bei München,DE85774

festivals.name: Spring Breakdown Festival
festivals.description: Spring Breakdown Festival is a DIY, non-profit metalcore/hardcore celebration in Dillenburg's Hofgarten since 2012. The one-day event maintains a strict anti-discrimination policy, emphasizing that 'Hardcore is, was and remains political.'

festivals.name: Freienfelser Ritterspiele
festivals.description: Freienfelser Ritterspiele is one of Germany's oldest and largest medieval events on 150,000 sqm, featuring Hesse's largest show tournament with Hollywood stuntmen. Over 2,000 campers, musicians, and knights gather at Burg Freienfels, with proceeds supporting castle restoration.

festivals.name: Vegan Fantasy Fair - Das vegane Fantasy Festival
Konstanzer Seenachtfest
festivals.description: Konstanzer Seenachtfest is the largest summer festival on Lake Constance, featuring one of Europe's biggest lake fireworks displays. The free event offers acrobats, dancers, fire artists, and DJs along the lakeside promenade, climaxing in a spectacular drone show and music fireworks.

festivals.city: Rathausplatz bis Sparkassenplatz Weil am Rhein

festivals.name: Schlosshof Festival
festivals.description: Medieval festival with rock, folk, and gothic music in the historic castle courtyard in Höchstadt. Features medieval market, good acoustics, and camping at the 800-year-old venue near Nuremberg.
festivals.venue: Schlosshof, Schlossberg, 91315 Höchstadt an der Aisch

festivals.name: Just Love Festival
festivals.venue: Shree Peetha Nilaya Ashram & Event CentreAm Geisberg 1-8Springen - Heidenrod,DE65321

festivals.name: Woodstock Forever Festival
festivals.description: Woodstock Forever Festival offers '5 days of love, peace & music' at the idyllic Feriendorf Auenland in the Thuringian Forest since 2003. Around 30 international bands perform across 3 stages with panoramic views over Thuringia and Bavaria, with free entry for children.
festivals.venue: Feriendorf Auenland, Zum Burgberg 1, 98673 Eisfeld OT Waffenrod

festivals.name: Walhalla - Festival der Helden
festivals.description: Walhalla – Festival der Helden is an unforgettable Viking experience for metal and medieval rock fans at Holstenhallen Neumünster. The indoor festival features a Viking market, tattoo artists, and around 3,000 metalheads celebrating with camping available on-site.

festivals.name: Sommerwerft Festival
festivals.description: Sommerwerft celebrates its 25th anniversary in 2026 as Frankfurt's beloved International Theatre Festival on the River. For 17 days, the Main riverbanks transform into an artistic village with free theater, dance, circus, music, and film under the shadow of the European Central Bank.

festivals.name: Lucky Lake Festival
festivals.description: Lucky Lake Festival is a familiar, friendly day festival at Strandbad Losheim since 2015, created by artist friends and organizers. Limited to 5,000 fans, it delivers quality techno and house on Main and Techno stages at the scenic Losheimer Stausee.

festivals.name: Die Schlagerwelle
festivals.venue: Ferien- und Freizeitpark Weissenhäuser StrandSeestraße 1Weissenhäuser Strand,DE23758

festivals.name: Kulturarena Jena
festivals.description: Seven-week open-air cultural festival on Jena's Theatervorplatz featuring diverse concerts, theater, and film evenings. From newcomers to superstars, the festival offers a unique platform under the open sky from July to August.

festivals.name: Sommerland Festival
festivals.description: Holistic wellness festival on an idyllic farm between Bielefeld and Osnabrück featuring yoga, healing work, dance workshops, meditation, and mantra singing. Vegetarian cuisine and evening music program in a camping-friendly setting.

festivals.name: Keep it Low Festival
festivals.description: Stoner rock, doom, and heavy psych festival at Munich's Backstage venue. Two-day gathering for fans of heavy, groove-laden rock with an emphasis on underground and cult acts.

festivals.name: Waves Open Air
festivals.description: Open-air techno festival at a public swimming pool venue near Hannover featuring three stages. Barrier-free and accessible with top electronic acts in a unique outdoor setting.

festivals.name: Shifted Festival
festivals.description: Independent festival for lovers of trance, groove, and hard techno in a secret forest location near Berlin. Creates an intimate club atmosphere outdoors with attention to detail and dedicated awareness team.

festivals.name: Sunset Beach Festival
festivals.venue: Strandbad Halterner StauseeHullerner Straße 52Haltern am See,DE45721

festivals.name: Lacuna Festival
festivals.description: Electronic music festival in Münsterland featuring mainstage, 360° forest stage, and techno areas. A world beyond the everyday where dreamers meet, let go, and feel free through four days of dancing.

festivals.name: PollerWiesen Opening
festivals.description: Legendary Cologne open-air techno event celebrating 30 years of rave culture at Jugendpark on the Rhine. Features daytime dancing from noon until evening with afterparty at Bootshaus club.

festivals.name: Prophecy Fest
festivals.description: Unique dark music gathering in the legendary Balver Höhle (Balve Cave), featuring Prophecy Productions artists. The atmospheric cave setting creates an unparalleled experience for fans of atmospheric, gothic, and experimental metal.

festivals.name: Ab geht die Lutzi! Festival
festivals.description: Award-winning indie and rock festival in rural Bavaria known for fair pricing and accessibility. Features a mix of established and emerging German acts in an intimate village setting with dedicated awareness team.

festivals.name: New Healing Festival
festivals.description: Week-long transformational festival in the idyllic Kümmernitztal combining psytrance, healing workshops, yoga, and meditation. Focuses on personal growth and community with daily workshops followed by electronic music celebration.

festivals.venue: Campus Poppelsdorf | vor der MNL BibFriedrich-Hierzebruch-Allee 4Bonn,DE53115

festivals.name: Auerworld Festival
festivals.description: Non-commercial atmospheric open-air festival held at the unique Auerworld Palace, a living willow dome cathedral built in 1998. Features diverse music from grunge to house, yoga sessions, and art in a magical setting near Jena.

festivals.name: Golden Leaves Festival
festivals.description: Intimate indie rock festival in the beautiful Schlosspark Kranichstein, Darmstadt. The 13th edition features a handpicked mix of established acts and hidden gems across two days of late summer music.

festivals.name: Morgenland Festival Osnabrück
festivals.description: Pioneering world music festival since 2005, bridging cultures from the Mediterranean to Central Asia. The 2026 edition focuses on 'Voices of the Diaspora' under new artistic director Shabnam Parvaresh.

festivals.name: Herzberg Festival
festivals.description: Europe's largest hippie festival at the historic Burg Herzberg castle, running since 1968. Features folk, blues, pop-rock and singer-songwriter music in a family-friendly atmosphere with free entry for children.

festivals.name: Nibirii Festival
festivals.description: Three-day electronic music festival at the scenic Dürener Badesee near Cologne featuring stages on the beach and in the forest. One of Germany's strongest lineups spanning techno, hardtechno, psytrance, and drum & bass.

festivals.name: SMAG Sundance Festival
festivals.description: One of Germany's most popular one-day electronic music open-airs, celebrating 20 years at Seaside Beach on Essen's Baldeneysee. A beloved institution in the Ruhr region's club scene.

festivals.name: Toxicator Festival
festivals.description: One of Germany's biggest hardcore and hardstyle indoor festivals at Mannheim's Maimarkthalle. Ten hours of relentless harder styles across three floors featuring top acts in hardcore, hardstyle, and hardtechno.

festivals.name: Stimmen Festival
festivals.description: Renowned month-long festival celebrating the human voice, running since 1994 in Lörrach near Basel. Features diverse concerts in unique locations from market squares to idyllic churches and parks.

festivals.name: Jazztage Görlitz
festivals.description: Prestigious 12-day jazz festival running since 1996, celebrating its 30th edition in 2026. Combines world-class jazz performances with Görlitz's extraordinary thousand-year-old architecture and unique urban venues.
festivals.venue: Various historic venues including Fischmarkt, Regional Court, and Annenkapelle

festivals.name: Kulturufer
festivals.description: Ten-day lakeside festival on Lake Constance featuring over 200 artists across theater, music, dance, cabaret, and acrobatics. Draws 130,000 visitors to enjoy street art, concerts, open-air cinema, and family activities.
