Dark Days Berlin
festivals.description: Two-day gothic culture festival at the historic Theater im Delphi combining dark metal, elektro, spoken word, and literature. A safe space celebration with a theme inspired by the goddess from Metropolis.

festivals.name: Bautz Festival
festivals.description: Multi-genre festival in Lüdenscheid featuring hip-hop, pop, rock, and elektro across four stages including the unique Alma de Mallorca and Turntable stages.

festivals.name: Nature One
festivals.description: One of Europe's largest electronic music festivals celebrating 30 years at the legendary former missile base Pydna. Over 350 DJs across 20 stages from massive open-air floors to intimate bunker clubs.

festivals.name: Helene Beach Open Air
festivals.description: Three-day electronic music festival on the shores of Helenesee lake near Frankfurt/Oder. Features over 50 acts across 4 stages with beach vibes, water sports, and sustainable camping.

festivals.name: San Hejmo Festival
festivals.description: NRW's most colorful feel-good festival at Airport Weeze for 75,000 visitors. Combines pop, hip-hop, and electronic music with art and culture over two vibrant days.
festivals.venue: Airport Weeze, Willy Brandt Ring, 47652 Weeze

festivals.name: Indian Spirit Festival
festivals.description: Germany's largest psytrance festival since 1999, celebrating six days in a magical forest setting near Eldena. Features multiple stages of full-on, progressive, darkpsy, plus a healing Chillout Garden with yoga and workshops.

festivals.name: Parookaville Festival
festivals.description: Germany's biggest electronic music festival celebrating its 10th anniversary. Transforms a former military airbase into a 'City of Dreams' with 225,000 citizens, 300+ DJs across 10 stages, from massive mainstage to intimate bunker clubs.

festivals.venue: Gigelberg, Biberach a.d. RissJahnstraße 1Biberach a.d. Riss,DE88400

festivals.name: World Club Dome
festivals.description: The 'Biggest Club in the World' at Frankfurt's Deutsche Bank Park. Three days of electronic music with 200+ DJs on 20+ stages pumping 1.8 million watts to 180,000 attendees.

festivals.description: Legendary psytrance gathering in an enchanted permanent forest venue since 1997. Four dancefloors of psychedelic music, art installations, yoga, and shamanic experiences beneath ancient trees.

festivals.venue: Haus im PulsObere Hauptstraße 31Neusiedl am See,AT7100

festivals.name: Electric Mountain Festival
festivals.description: Five-day EDM festival in the Ötztal Alps at 2,000+ meters, combining skiing and electronic music. 12th edition featuring international DJs from the Giggijoch fun zone to the ice Q summit restaurant.

festivals.name: Donaufestival
festivals.description: Prestigious contemporary arts festival since 1988, transforming historic Krems into a hub for experimental music, performance, visual arts, and discourse across two weekends in May.
festivals.venue: Minoritenkirche & Messegelände, Krems an der Donau

festivals.name: Electric Love Festival
festivals.description: Austria's premier EDM festival at the scenic Salzburgring with 180,000 visitors from 70 nations. 200+ artists on 7 stages including massive mainstage and hard-hitting Q-dance stage, plus shuttle to alpine lake beach.

festivals.name: Lovely Days Festival
festivals.description: Classic rock festival since 2006 in the idyllic Schlosspark Esterházy, bringing the biggest stars of the 60s and 70s to Eisenstadt. A cult event for fans of rock legends.

festivals.name: Nova Rock Festival
festivals.description: Austria's biggest rock festival since 2005 at Pannonia Fields, hosting 105,000+ fans for four days. The 22nd edition introduces a fifth stage with headliners spanning classic rock to modern metalcore.

festivals.name: Kaltenbach Open Air
festivals.description: Austria's oldest extreme metal open air since 2003, celebrating its 19th edition. Three days of 36 bands in the stunning Kaltenbachgraben valley of the Styrian Alps with 1,500 dedicated fans.

festivals.name: Snowbombing Festival
festivals.description: Europe's biggest snow and music festival since 2005 in the Tyrolean ski resort of Mayrhofen. Six days of mountain activities and world-class performances in unique alpine venues from igloos to forest raves.

festivals.name: Woodstock der Blasmusik
festivals.description: Europe's largest brass music festival attracting 100,000 fans. Four days of 150+ acts on 9 stages celebrating 'Love, Peace & Blasmusik' in Austria's Innviertel region.
festivals.venue: Woodstock Arco Area, Kopfing im Innkreis

festivals.name: Vienna Metal Meeting
festivals.description: Vienna's premier one-day metal pilgrimage at Arena Wien since 2017. A mainstay of the Austrian metal scene featuring international headliners from black, death, and progressive metal.

festivals.name: picture on Festival
festivals.description: Intimate rock festival since 2000 in the tiny 350-soul village of Bildein, Burgenland. Main stage under a huge plane tree next to the church creates a family-friendly, familiar atmosphere.

festivals.name: One Love Festival
festivals.description: Austria's largest reggae festival celebrating 50 years of Wiesen festival culture. Two days of roots, dub, dancehall and world music with legendary artists and a welcoming family-friendly atmosphere.

festivals.name: FM4 Frequency Festival
festivals.description: One of Austria's biggest music festivals since 2001, drawing 140,000 fans to Green Park St. Pölten. Features international rock, indie, and alternative acts just 30 minutes from Vienna with camping by the river.

festivals.name: Donauinselfest
festivals.description: The world's largest free open-air music festival with 3 million visitors over three days. Transforms Vienna's Danube Island into a 4.5km party with 16 stages spanning rock, pop, electronic, and more.

festivals.name: BERGFESTival
festivals.description: Winter festival combining ski opening, rock open air, and club parties in snowy Saalbach. Main stage concerts in the village center with mountain panorama performances at Hinterhag-Alm.

festivals.name: Rave on Snow Festival
festivals.description: Austria's oldest winter electronic music festival since 1993, combining Alpine skiing with 70+ DJs across 12 floors. Three days and nights of raving in the snow-covered mountains of Saalbach.

festivals.name: Waves Festival
festivals.description: Vienna's annual music showcase festival and conference for Central and Eastern European talent. Three days of discovering emerging artists across the city's clubs, off-locations, and public spaces along the Gürtel.
festivals.venue: Various clubs and venues along Vienna's Gürtel

festivals.name: Szene Open Air
festivals.description: Austria's only multi-day festival west of Salzburg, running since 1990. Three days of hip-hop, indie-pop, and pop at the scenic Alter Rhein with camping, festival kindergarten, and sustainability focus.

festivals.name: poolbar Festival
festivals.description: Unique 40-day cultural festival since 1994 at Feldkirch's former indoor swimming pool. Combines concerts with cinema, cabaret, poetry slam, and fashion at the crossroads of Austria, Germany, Liechtenstein, and Switzerland.

festivals.venue: Lungolago and Old Town Borgo, Ascona

festivals.name: m4music Festival
festivals.description: Switzerland's premier pop music discovery festival run by Migros Culture Percentage since 1997. Two days of emerging Swiss artists across five stages at Zurich's Schiffbau cultural center.

festivals.name: Open Air Frauenfeld
festivals.description: Europe's largest hip-hop festival and Switzerland's biggest open-air, held in Thurgau between Zurich and Lake Constance. Known for its intense camping atmosphere and uncompromising focus on hip-hop.

festivals.name: Zürich OpenAir
festivals.description: Zurich's largest and most popular festival near the airport, featuring electronic, rock, and pop music. Four days of international acts with easy access from downtown Zurich and abroad.

festivals.name: Blues Festival Basel
festivals.description: 24th edition of Basel's premier blues festival, featuring four evenings at the legendary Atlantis Basel. International stars and Swiss blues personalities in an intimate club setting.

festivals.name: Greenfield Festival
festivals.description: Switzerland's biggest rock festival at Interlaken Airport with stunning Alpine panorama views of Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau. Features 40+ bands across two stages plus medieval village with axe-throwing and metalchurch.

festivals.name: SummerDays Festival
festivals.description: Two-day festival on the idyllic shores of Lake Constance in Arbon, featuring 12,000 daily visitors. Unique blend of open-air music, fun fair, and food festival with free public transport from anywhere in Switzerland.

festivals.name: Gurtenfestival
festivals.description: Switzerland's legendary four-day festival on Bern's local mountain since 1984, now in its 43rd edition. Nearly 80,000 music lovers pilgrimage to the hilltop venue accessible by funicular for an iconic Swiss experience.

festivals.name: Open Air Lumnezia
festivals.description: Historic Swiss open air since 1985 in the heart of Val Lumnezia, surrounded by 360 degrees of mountains. The 'big festival in small format' draws 18,000 to the alpine plateau near Davos.

festivals.name: Open Air Gampel
festivals.description: Wild five-day festival deep in the Swiss Alps since 1986, where mountains meet music. Multiple themed bars, 24-hour partying, and past headliners like Foo Fighters, Tool, and The Cure.

festivals.name: Meh Suff! Metalfestival
festivals.description: Swiss metal festival in Hüttikon featuring an underground and international lineup. Known for their winter edition in Zurich and main summer festival in September.

festivals.name: Buskers Bern
festivals.description: Unique street music festival since 2004, transforming Bern's UNESCO old town into an open-air stage. 150 artists from around the world perform for 60,000 visitors who pay artists directly by tipping.
festivals.venue: Bern Old Town, between Kornhaus and Nydegg

festivals.name: Irish Openair Toggenburg
festivals.description: Where Irish joie de vivre meets the Alpine foothills - two days of Celtic music across 3 stages with original Irish pubs, medieval market, and camping in idyllic Toggenburg.

festivals.name: OpenAir St.Gallen
festivals.description: Pioneering sustainable festival since 1977, now in its 48th edition at the scenic Sittertobel. A European festival scene institution known for ecology, transparency, and 30,000 daily visitors across multiple stages.

festivals.name: Burning Mountain Festival
festivals.description: Four-day psychedelic art and music experience at 1,500m in the Swiss Engadine Alps. Non-stop psytrance on 40 acres next to the river Inn, plus yoga, workshops, and fire performances.
